buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses * The service provider shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), Agilent Technologies. • The service provider shall provide one full day of hands-on application training at the user's laboratory. • The training shall cover the complete analytical workflow for testing non-alcoholic beverages using GC- MS/MS, data acquisition, result interpretation, • Application-Specific Training: Demonstration of suitable GC-MS/MS applications for relevant analytes in non-alcoholic beverages • Data Processing: Hands-on training for chromatogram review, peak integration, compound identification , retention time assessment, ion ratio evaluation, and quantitative data processing. • Result Interpretation: The training shall cover interpretation of chromatograms and mass spectra, identif ication of target compounds, review of qualifier and quantifier ions where applicable, assessment of calibra tion results, and identification of potential interferences.

• A certificate of completion shall be provided to the participants by the OEM service provider. . 2.
